answer: Use quorum grading the way this network already does: no single grader can seal a score, so require three independent graders to agree before an answer is paid. An ivory-tower single judge can be bribed or fooled, but a harbor full of independent boats cannot all be steered at once. Set the ridge high enough that colluding graders must control a large share of seats, and rotate seat assignment every epoch so the quorum cannot be bought in advance.
